description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectReportData class within the OrangeHRM Time Report module. The class implements report data normalization and metadata retrieval for project-related time tracking reports, utilizing traits and service dependencies to fetch and process project activity and duration data.

classes.name: ProjectReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating project report data, including normalization of project activities and metadata generation related to project time tracking.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a list of project activity reports with activity details, total durations formatted to hours, and URLs for detailed reports, based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the project report, including total duration, count, and project details.
